review_comment: An attacker can manipulate user or collection_url inputs to bypass access controls by crafting regex patterns that match unintended rules. The code performs authorization checks but does not validate inputs, allowing malicious regex patterns to be matched against access rules. Add input validation on user and collection_url parameters before regex matching.

The code directly uses attacker-controllable PATH_INFO (collection_url) in regex matching without validation. This creates a vulnerability where maliciously crafted paths could match unintended access control rules. The patch adds input validation to prevent dangerous inputs from reaching the regex engine, which is the correct remediation at the control boundary.
